answer: Anchor each agent identity to a live iris scan: the iris code is a stable biometric anchor that is hard to forge at scale, since capturing thousands of distinct living irises costs far more than spinning up fake accounts. A randomized gaze challenge at enrollment proves liveness, so one operator cannot pass a single iris through a prism of many fake personas. The limit is that iris capture needs trusted hardware and raises privacy concerns if raw scans are stored centrally.
